Konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni kudumisa u Allah. Umbuso ungowaKhe nodumo lungolwaKhe, futhi unamandla okwenza noma yini.
Nguyena owanidala; kwaba khona abangakholwa kini kanye nabakholwayo. Belu u Allah ukubona konke enikwenzayo.
Udale amazulu nomhlaba ngeqiniso futhi wanibumba wanenza nabahle; kanti isiphetho sikuYe.
Wazi konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni futhi Wazi konke enikufihlile nenikuveze obala; ngokuba u Allah ukwazi konke okuthukuswe ezifubeni.
Aniyitholanga indaba yalabo abaphika ukholo endulo na?; bazivuna izithelo zemisebenzi yabo futhi bathola isijeziso esibuhlungu.
Lokho yingoba kwakuthi uma iZithunywa zabo ziletha izibonakaliso, bathi: “Singaholwa umuntu na?” Baphika ukholo bafulathela; kepha u Allah akadingi lutho, ngokuba u Allah Uzimele Uyadunyiswa.
Labo abangakholwa baqagula ukuthi abasoze bavuswa; yithi: “Nebala, ngiyifunge iNkosi yami, niyakuvuswa futhi naziswe ngezenzo zenu, bheka ngoba lokho kuyinto elula ku Allah”.
Kholwanike ku Allah neSithunywa Sakhe kanye neNkanyiso ayehlisela; u Allah ukuqaphile enikwenzayo.

Ngosuku lapho eyonibuthanisa ngalo, ngoSuku lokuButhana, lelo kuyakuba uSuku lokuGqama kokuLahlekelwa. Lowo okholwa ku Allah wenza okuhle Uyomesulela amacala akhe futhi amungenise ezivandeni okugeleza imifula ngaphansi kwazo, ahlale khona unaphakade; iyonake leyo impumelelo enkulu.
Kepha labo abaphika ukholo bachithe nezambulo Zethu ngamanga; yiboke labo abayobhadla eMlilweni unaphakade; saze sasibi isiphetho.
Asikho isehlakalo esehlayo ngaphandle kwemvumo ka Allah; lowo okholwa ku Allah uyakuyihola inhliziyo yakhe, ngokuba u Allah unolwazi lwakho konke.
Thobelani u Allah neSithunywa; kepha uma nidikila, umsebenzi weSithunywa Sethu ukwethula umlayezo ocacile.
U Allah, akekho omunye ofanele ukukhonzwa ngaphandle kwaKhe; ngakhoke abakholwayo mababeke ithemba labo ku Allah.
Nina enikholwayo! Ebafazini benu nasezinganeni zenu kunesitha senu, ngakhoke baqapheleni. Kepha uma nixolela noma nidlulisa futhi nithethelele, u Allah Uyathethelela Unomusa.
Nebala, umcebo wenu nezingane zenu ziyisivivinyo, kepha u Allah unomvuzo omkhulu.
Ngakhoke, thobelani u Allah ngokusemandleni enu, nilalele nihloniphe futhi nanelane, ikona okungcono kini. Kantike lowo ohlengwe emoneni womphefumulo wakhe, ngempela, ungophumeleleyo.
Uma niboleka u Allah imboleko enhle, uyakuyiphindaphinda futhi anithethelele, bheka ngoba u Allah Uyazisa Unobubele.
